question: Who has the authority to transfer judges of the High Courts in India?

options.text: Chief Justice of India acting on behalf of the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The authority to transfer judges of High Courts in India lies with the **President of India** as per Article 222 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The transfer is carried out based on the recommendation of the **Chief Justice of India** (CJI).
 
• The President, after consulting the CJI, issues the transfer order to ensure judicial independence and administrative efficiency.
 
• Such transfers are aimed at preventing favoritism, ensuring impartiality, and maintaining the integrity of the judiciary.
 
• Judges being transferred are entitled to receive **compensatory allowances** as specified under the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 222 of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• It empowers the President to transfer a judge from one High Court to another after consulting the Chief Justice of India.
 
• The transferred judge is eligible for compensatory allowances as determined by law.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Chief Justice of India:**
 
 
• The Chief Justice of India plays a crucial role in advising the President on the transfer of judges.
 
• Consultation with the Chief Justice ensures transparency and impartiality in the decision-making process.
 
 
 
• **Independence of the Judiciary:**
 
 
• Transfers prevent favoritism and ensure that judges do not develop undue influence in a particular region.
 
• This practice upholds the principle of judicial independence and impartiality.
 
 
 
• **Compensatory Allowances:**
 
 
• Judges who are transferred to another High Court are entitled to compensatory allowances as per constitutional provisions.
 
• These allowances are meant to cover expenses incurred due to relocation and ensure financial stability.
